name: speaker-circle
title: Speaker Circle
description: Attachment snippet, no markup of its own: apply it to the host's element and drive it from the host timeline with the recipe in the file. The speaker's recording in a round window with no outline over a vertical reel: opens large (1.95x) in the centre of the frame, then moves between the places you give it (time, centre, size 1x–1.95x) or leaves the frame for full-screen graphics and comes back. The window grows, the face is never zoomed.
